question.text: Meera wants to set up an AIF that aggregates offshore and domestic corpus into a domestic SEBI-registered AIF. This is called:

explanation.text: The Logic: A unified structure (pp. 106-108) routes offshore fund capital into the domestic SEBI-registered AIF and aggregates offshore and domestic corpus into the domestic AIF. The Trap: Parallel structure uses separate pooling vehicles for different investor groups. "Pure domestic" and "pure offshore" describe single-side structures rather than the cross-border aggregation that defines a unified structure. Note: The workbook table for unified structure still shows two pooling vehicles, so it should not be described as having only one fund vehicle. The defining feature is the aggregation of offshore and domestic corpus into the domestic AIF.
